name: attack_sequence
summary: One attack action by loadout: the attack, the jab, the full attack, or the circle cut, each strike its own roll through the combat pipeline.

action.description: The action (actions/core.json); its strikes and AP come from the loadout's attack_sequences row.

ap.description: The attacker's AP left. A full attack and a circle cut spend all of it and need at least the attack AP + full_attack.min_extra_ap; an attack or a jab with fewer than its AP is an error.

off_skill.description: The off-hand weapon skill; the main-hand skill when left out.

flags.description: Flags from conditions, as in combat.

weapon_properties.description: The main-hand weapon's properties, as combat's attacker.weapon_properties.

weapon_effects.description: The main-hand weapon's on-hit applied effects (a bound weapon's bane, lingering damage, ...), as combat's attacker.weapon_effects.

off_weapon_properties.description: The off-hand weapon's properties; none when left out.

off_weapon_effects.description: The off-hand weapon's on-hit applied effects; none when left out: an off-hand weapon never borrows the main hand's.

modifiers.description: The attacker's perks: adds on full_attack_strikes, full_attack_off_strikes, mainhand_penalty, offhand_penalty, and the carry_through, reaping_arc, scissor_cut, and can_circle_cut grants.

items.description: A combat defender (combat.json input defender), without the attack's rolls.

foes.description: The foes in reach, in the order a carry picks them; foe 0 is a full attack's target.

damage.description: The main-hand damage type and attribute; each strike's roll is in rolls.

off_damage.description: The off-hand damage type and attribute; damage when left out.

rolls.description: One attack roll and one damage roll per strike made, in order; a lost strike takes none.

targets.description: An attack's or a jab's foe per strike (indexes into foes); all 0 when left out.

situations.description: Keys in ruleset/data/combat/situations.json for every strike, as in combat (flanking, beside_summon, ...).

summoning.description: Whether the attacker has an active summon (not a minion), for every strike's while_summoning modifiers, as in combat. Default false.

attack.description: The strike's attack value after the penalty perks.

carried.description: The strike went to another foe because its own dropped (carry_through).

free.description: The free strike carry_through gives after an action's last strike drops a foe.

scissor.description: Scissor Cut counted the off-hand dice once more.

weapon_effects.description: The weapon effects that landed, as combat's; listed only when the strike's hand has weapon effects.

hp.description: Each foe's HP after the action.

lost.description: Strikes lost because their foe dropped and nothing carried them.
